components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1.5px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:var(--primary,#111418); color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff); font:600 14px "Archivo Variable",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary,#111418) 85%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring,#111418); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring,#111418) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.css: .ds-band { display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:40px; height:60px; padding:0 48px; background:var(--band,#111418); color:var(--band-foreground,#fff); font-family:"Archivo Variable",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-band-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:var(--band-foreground,#fff); font-size:19px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-band-bullet { position:relative; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--band-foreground,#fff); } .ds-band-bullet::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--band,#111418); } .ds-band-nav { display:flex; } .ds-band-link { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:4px 18px 0; border-bottom:4px solid transparent; color:var(--band-muted,#b8bdc3); font-size:15px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-band-link:hover { color:var(--band-foreground,#fff); border-bottom-color:var(--band-rule,#3a4048); } .ds-band-link.is-active { color:var(--band-foreground,#fff); border-bottom-color:var(--band-foreground,#fff); } .ds-band-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--band-foreground,#fff); outline-offset:-8px; border-radius:4px; }

components.css: .ds-stations { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(110px,1fr)); gap:16px; font-family:"Archivo Variable",Arial,sans-serif; color:var(--foreground,#111418); } .ds-station { position:relative; display:grid; justify-items:center; align-content:start; gap:10px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9dce0); font-size:16px; } .ds-station::before, .ds-station::after { content:""; position:absolute; top:17px; height:8px; background:var(--rule-strong,#111418); } .ds-station::before { left:-8px; right:50%; } .ds-station::after { left:50%; right:-8px; } .ds-station:first-child::before, .ds-station:last-child::after { display:none; } .ds-station.is-offer::after, .ds-station.is-rejected::before { top:19px; height:0; background:none; border-top:4px dashed var(--stop-closed,#9aa0a6); } .ds-station-bullet { position:relative; z-index:1; display:grid; place-items:center; width:42px; height:42px; box-sizing:border-box; border:6px solid var(--rule-strong,#111418); border-radius:50%; background:var(--background,#fff); font-size:15px; font-weight:800; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-station.is-offer .ds-station-bullet { border-color:var(--signal-done,#00933c); } .ds-station.is-rejected .ds-station-bullet { border-color:var(--stop-closed,#9aa0a6); color:var(--muted-foreground,#5b6168); } .ds-station small { margin-top:-8px; color:var(--muted-foreground,#5b6168); font-size:12px; }

components.css: .ds-tile { width:240px; padding:16px 16px 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--rule-strong,#111418); border-radius:6px; background:var(--card,#fff); color:var(--foreground,#111418); font-family:"Archivo Variable",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-tile h3 { margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.25; } .ds-tile p { margin:3px 0 0; color:var(--muted-foreground,#5b6168); font-size:13px; } .ds-stops { position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin:14px 0 13px; padding-bottom:13px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9dce0); } .ds-stops::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:4px; right:4px; top:calc(50% - 7px); height:2px; background:var(--border,#d9dce0); } .ds-stops i { position:relative; width:9px; height:9px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid var(--stop-off,#b9bec4); border-radius:50%; background:var(--card,#fff); } .ds-stops i.is-done { border-color:var(--rule-strong,#111418); background:var(--rule-strong,#111418); } .ds-stops i.is-now { width:13px; height:13px; border-color:var(--rule-strong,#111418); background:var(--rule-strong,#111418); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--card,#fff), 0 0 0 4.5px var(--rule-strong,#111418); } .ds-next { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; color:var(--foreground,#111418); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-next:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-next:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring,#111418); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; } .ds-dot { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; } .ds-dot.is-action { background:var(--signal-action,#ee352e); }

components.css: .ds-legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px 18px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; color:var(--muted-foreground,#5b6168); font:400 12px "Archivo Variable",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-legend li { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; } .ds-sig { position:relative; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; } .ds-sig.is-action { background:var(--signal-action,#ee352e); } .ds-sig.is-ai { background:var(--signal-ai,#0039a6); } .ds-sig.is-wait { background:var(--signal-wait,#fccc0a); } .ds-sig.is-done { background:var(--signal-done,#00933c); } .ds-sig.is-live::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:-4px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--signal-ai,#0039a6); opacity:0; animation:ds-breathe 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0% { transform:scale(0.6); opacity:0.7; } 100% { transform:scale(1.5); opacity:0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sig.is-live::after { animation:none; opacity:0.35; } }

narrative.overview:
The app reads like a subway map. Each job you apply to rides one line through five stops: Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, and a Rejected branch. Home is the system map. A black signage band runs across the top like station signs, and a few bright signal colors tell you what to do next. The rest is white paper and near-black ink.

It is light-first because people use it at a desk during the day. Dark mode keeps the same map with a deep ink ground. Density is medium: tight enough to see every job at once, with real space between sections. Type does the heavy lifting with one family, Archivo, at strong weights. Color is never decoration. If something is colored, it is telling you something.

This world replaced an older "paper and forest" look. Nothing from that look carries over: no warm paper ground, no green primary, no per-section accent colors.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink type (#111418), cool grays for quiet text and hairlines.
A black signage band holds navigation, with a thick white underline under the current section.
Four signal colors, one meaning each, used the same way on every page.
Round station bullets and thick lines that only appear where they show progress.
Archivo for everything, from the 44px Home title down to 12px labels.
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from ink rules and borders, not shadows.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red means needs you, blue means AI working, yellow means waiting on someone else, green means offer or success. A signal color never shows up for any other reason, including decoration, links, charts, or section color.

rules.name: The No Fifth Signal Rule
rules.body: In-between states like "partial" or "could improve" use plain ink (`foreground`), not a signal. Only the four meanings above get color.

rules.name: The Fill vs. Text Rule
rules.body: Dots, lines, and borders use the plain signal token. Words and icons use the `-text` token. Never set small text in the fill color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface. Don't bring in a second display or mono font.

rules.name: The Bold Sign Rule
rules.body: Headings are 700 or 800. Nothing between body weight and bold is used for headings in the Transit Line surfaces.

rules.name: The Ink Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand apart, give it an ink border or rule. Don't add a drop shadow to tiles, cards, or panels that sit in the page.

dos: Do use the four signals only for their one meaning: red needs you (including failures), blue AI working, yellow waiting on someone else, green offer or success.
Do use the `-text` token whenever a signal colors words or icons, and the plain token for dots, lines, and borders.
Do show "partial" and "could improve" in plain ink.
Do draw Rejected as a dashed gray branch off the line, never as the stop after Offer.
Do separate things with ink rules (2px) and hairlines (1px) instead of shadows.
Do keep the breathing blue ring as the only looping motion, and turn it off under reduced motion.
Do stack the board into a vertical list of stations on phones.
Do keep Archivo at 700 to 800 for headings and use tabular numbers for counts.
donts: Don't use a signal color for decoration, links, charts, or to tell sections apart.
Don't add a fifth status color for in-between states.
Don't put small white text on a signal fill; it doesn't have enough contrast.
Don't draw thick colored lines where nothing is progressing.
Don't bring back the old paper-and-forest look: warm paper ground, green primary, or per-section accent colors.
Don't build the gray-sidebar kanban with pastel status pills that most job trackers ship.
Don't add drop shadows to tiles or panels that sit in the page.
